The operating system platform identifier.

## Signature

```typescript
platform: string;
```

## Remarks

Common values include:

<ul> <li><code>darwin</code> (macOS)</li> <li><code>linux</code> (Linux)</li> <li><code>win32</code> (Windows)</li> </ul>

Corresponds to <code>process.platform</code> from Node.js.
